config.script:
programid=self.view.params.program
	basepath=self.session.custom.machineInfo.basePath
	taglist=[
		    "{}/WO/PO".format(basepath),
		    "{}/WO/serial_number".format(basepath),
		    "{}/WO/Start_time".format(basepath),
		    "{}/WO/status".format(basepath)
		]
	# ---- QC gate: block completion unless quality checks are COMPLETED ----
	serial_number = self.view.custom.jobid
	qcStatus = quality_report.getJobQcStatus(serial_number, display=True)
	system.perspective.print(qcStatus)
	system.perspective.print(serial_number)
	logger = system.util.getLogger("logger")
	if qcStatus != 'Completed':
		logger.warn("Completion blocked - QC not complete | SN=%s, qcStatus=%s"
					% (str(serial_number), str(qcStatus)))
		friendly = {
			'NOT_STARTED': "Quality checks have not been started for this job.",
			'IN_PROGRESS': "Quality checks are not yet completed for this job.",
			'FAILED':      "Quality checks have failed for this job."
		}.get(qcStatus, "Quality checks are not completed for this job.")
		params = {
			"action": "error",
			"primaryText": "Cannot complete job",
			"secondaryText": friendly
		}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view="Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up",
									params=params,
									showCloseIcon=False,
									draggable=False,
									modal=True)
	if qcStatus == 'Completed':	
		currentWO=system.tag.readBlocking(taglist)
		PO=currentWO[0].value
		serialnumber=currentWO[1].value
		workstatus=currentWO[3].value
		params = {	"action": "confirm",
					"secondaryText":"Do you really want to Complete the Job!","program_name":programid,"serial_number":serialnumber,"work_status":workstatus,"PO":PO}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = "Project/Pop-Up/Job_start_confirm", 
											params = params, 
											showCloseIcon = False,
											draggable = False, 
											modal = True)
